p: Silver Street is in the old part of Gainsborough town centre, close to the market place and the Marshall's Yard shopping area, built in the old Marshall's engineering works. This MERKUR is 18+ only, adults only.

Gainsborough Old Hall is the town's big gem, a remarkable medieval manor house with a timber-framed great hall and a brilliant medieval kitchen, right in the middle of town. The River Trent runs alongside, and on the right spring tides you can see the Aegir, a tidal bore that rolls up the river. Trains run from Gainsborough Lea Road and Central stations, so you can get here without the car.
